title: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)
text:
Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)

['From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>\\nCc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000\\nSubject: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)\\n\\nHi Erin —\\n\\nGreat to meet you over email. I’m Monica (AE on this account) — looping in Lauren (our Sales Manager) and Karthik (solutions/technical lead) so we can align on a pragmatic evaluation plan and close timeline.\\n\\nGoal in this thread: confirm success criteria, key stakeholders, and a realistic timeline so we can land a pilot and commercial decision cleanly. My proposal below is meant to be a starting point we can adjust:\\n\\nHigh-level objectives\\n- Validate model quality on your anonymized customer transcripts\\n- Measure latency/throughput for your production SLAs\\n- Estimate per-call unit economics with suggested batching/cache profile\\n\\nProposed 6-week timeline (flexible)\\n1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff + stakeholder roster + access checklist\\n2) Week 1: technical baseline & dataset handoff\\n3) Week 2–3: pilot runs and initial eval metrics\\n4) Week 4: cross-functional review (product & security)\\n5) Week 5: business review & exec summary\\n6) Week 6: contract & procurement loop close (if green)\\n\\nAttachments: I attached a starting MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) with responsibilities, dates, and deliverables. Can you confirm:\\n- Who will be the Heliox champion for the pilot?\\n- Any mandatory procurement milestones we should account for? (PO, vendor packages, third-party security review)\\n- Any blackout dates in July we should avoid for demo/live runs?\\n\\nSuggested next step: 30-min sync this week to finalize the roster and lock the kickoff date. I’m available Thu 7/1 10–12 PT or Fri 7/2 09–11 PT — if neither works, propose a time that does.\\n\\nThanks —\\nMonica Patel\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\nmonica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0127\\n\\n--\\nAttachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; contains milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria)', 'From: Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>\\nTo: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Samir Khan <samir.k@heliox.ai>\\nDate: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0000\\nSubject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)\\n\\nMonica — thanks for the clear note and the MAP draft. I’m happy to act as the Heliox champion for now. I’ve looped in Samir (Head of Platforms) — he’ll own the dataset and the technical side.\\n\\nA couple of constraints from our side:\\n- Procurement typically takes ~6 weeks for external vendors at our org, so the overall calendar will likely land closer to 8 weeks for contract completion.\\n- Security will want a quick pass at the SOC2 snapshot and evidence before pilot infra is provisioned — can you share an extracted PDF of the control summary?\\n- We have a company-wide freeze the week of July 19–23 (quarterly maintenance), so avoid demos that week.\\n\\nWith those constraints, proposed adjustments: move business review to Week 6 and contract week to Week 8. Still happy to proceed with a technical kickoff next week. Thu 7/1 10:30 PT works for me.\\n\\nBest,\\nErin Brooks\\nDirector of Product, Heliox Technologies\\nerin@heliox.ai | +1 415-555-3344\\n\\n> On Wed, 30 Jun 2027 at 09:12, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> > Hi Erin —\\n> > Great to meet you over email. I’m Monica (AE on this account) — looping in Lauren (our Sales Manager) and Karthik (solutions/technical lead) so we can align on a pragmatic evaluation plan and close timeline.\\n> > [snip]\\n\\n--\\nRequested: SOC2_snapshot.pdf (Heliox requested control summary PDF)', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>\\nCc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -0000\\nSubject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)\\n\\nThanks Erin — this is perfect context.\\n\\nI’ve updated the attached MAP to reflect an 8-week close and the July 19–23 freeze. See column "Adjusted Dates" in the workbook. I also included a short checklist for procurement (vendor packet, PO template, and contract owner).\\n\\nI’m attaching a SOC2 control snapshot (SOC2_snapshot.pdf) to accelerate the security pass. If security wants more detail we can provision the redacted report under NDA.\\n\\nWe’ll hold a 30-min technical kickoff Thu 7/1 at 10:30 PT to confirm data handoff and roles (invite sent). Proposed attendees: Erin, Samir, Karthik, myself, and an infra engineer (TBD). If you want a short pre-read, the Drive link has the MAP and the evaluation rubric: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/heliox/Redwood_MAP_v1\\n\\nNext steps (action owners):\\n- Erin / Samir: confirm dataset access and owner (by 7/2)\\n- Redwood (Karthik): provide infra checklist and temporary creds (by 7/2)\\n- Redwood (Monica): finalize kickoff agenda and send calendar invite (done)\\n\\nThanks — see you Thu.\\n\\nMonica Patel\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\nmonica.patel@redwood.ai\\n\\n--\\nAttachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOC2_snapshot.pdf', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>\\nDate: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:10:00 -0000\\nSubject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)\\n\\nQuick note ahead of the 10:30 PT kickoff — thanks for lining this up. A couple of operational asks so the pilot can start smoothly: \\n\\nTech checklist (what I’ll cover on the call)\\n- Minimal data sample: 10–20 anonymized transcripts + schema and retention policy\\n- Network whitelist (IP ranges) and temporary S3 access role or secure upload link\\n- Expected QPS/peak concurrency for the pilot environment\\n\\nIf you can share the sample and a point of contact for infra (Samir?) prior to the call we’ll provision a temporary cluster and smoke-test within 48 hours. I’ll also bring our cost/latency estimator so we can produce a short projection on the call.\\n\\nLooking forward —\\nKarthik Iyer\\nSolutions Lead, Redwood Inference\\nkarthik_iyer@redwood.ai\\n\\n> On Thu, 01 Jul 2027 at 08:46, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> > Thanks Erin — this is perfect context.\\n> > [snip]\\n']
